title: Lamar Jackson would "definitely" like Jadeveon Clowney back in Baltimore

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lamar Jackson would "definitely" like Jadeveon Clowney back in Baltimore
sources.description: Jadeveon Clowney tied his single-season high with 9.5 sacks while playing for the Ravens in 2023 and he left a good impression on quarterback Lamar Jackson during his time with the team.
